config._note: Org archetype (bespoke-detail-pages). A supplier is a trading organisation, so the body leads with the commercial-master fields (supplierId, displayName, category, status, termsOfTrade, leadTimeDays, preferred, catalog) 8-wide and the related graph (products this supplier is preferredSupplier for, its MDM masterEntityRef) 4-wide. The supplier's contact people render via the Contacts leaf — the schema declares a contactsUid FK into the Nextcloud address book, which is exactly what the contacts integration surfaces (this is the address-book link, NOT an email/calendar comms leaf; supplier declares no email/calendar linkedType, so those stay off the body). Purchase documents / price lists live in Documents full-width. NOTE: there is no purchaseOrder child schema in the register, so no object-list of POs is rendered; the supplier catalog is an ARRAY-on-object and auto-renders inside the data widget.
